symptom: A Python unittest wrapper reported two C++ runtime assertion failures for Moonlight::phase_from_date and Moonlight::days_since_1900, but Director quality repair authorized the unrelated first changed production file src/inkwell/cipher.cpp.
dynamic_evidence: The exact r66 workspace-validation residual contained only Moonlight::phase_from_date and Moonlight::days_since_1900 assertion failures.
Calling the current public causal-target resolver against that exact persisted residual returned tests/cpp_unit.cpp followed by src/inkwell/cipher.cpp and the broad changed-file frontier.
Calling _cpp_runtime_qualified_symbol_owner_target_files against the exact same residual returned an empty list even though src/inkwell/moonlight.cpp contains the qualified definition.

Instrumented helper inputs showed that tests/cpp_unit.cpp and src/inkwell/moonlight.cpp both contained the same qualified symbol text; the helper treated the test call-site as a second product owner and rejected the definition as ambiguous.
After the fix, the exact resolver returned tests/cpp_unit.cpp plus src/inkwell/moonlight.cpp, and Factory's production-owner filter returned only src/inkwell/moonlight.cpp.

r67 context snapshots 3b0669cf25511c3525c2231b and 886a4f6fc0a13c8dce1a4679 prove the real final provider request carried claim_hint_target_files, authorized_target_files, and repair target_files equal to only src/inkwell/moonlight.cpp, with its current UTF-8 body present.

r67 produced three physical edit_file effects on src/inkwell/moonlight.cpp. Candidate guards revalidated the exact unittest, classified every candidate as stagnant, restored the file hashes, and stopped at the three-nonprogress fuse. No candidate drifted to cipher.cpp.
root_cause: The qualified-symbol owner resolver searched test translation units together with production C/C++ sources. A test call expression and its product definition therefore became two textual owners; the unique-owner guard failed and routing fell back to changed-file order.

fix.invariant: Runtime qualified-symbol product-owner discovery excludes test-like C/C++ translation units. Compiler diagnostics retain their separate exact test-owner route.

verification.focused_red_green: new regression failed before the source fix and passed after it
verification.live_r67: real provider scope and all three physical edits stayed on src/inkwell/moonlight.cpp; candidate rollback and hard fuse remained fail-closed

residual.description: Owner routing and mutation/rollback accounting are now correct. MiniMax-M3 identified the Moonlight failure but emitted three incorrect date/phase edits; the edit-only repair surface provided no dynamic probe tool. A separate design must prove whether a bounded read-only diagnostic-probe subturn improves semantic convergence without restoring read-only repair loops.
